name: empty-state
description: Empty-state region: icon + heading + description + optional CTA. List-level empty states are done by repeater/table with their own emptyText; this is for page-level empty regions.
provenPattern: A pure arrangement with no state or behaviour of its own, so it is a composition rather than a block (arrangement-only → template).

knowledge.purpose: Meets a page-level empty region with icon, heading, description and an optional action
useCases: A page with no content produced yet
antiPatterns: Using it for an empty list or table — that is repeater/table emptyText's job
Writing only "No data" — an empty state must say what to do
Promising an action without placing a button
An h2 not-found title on a page whose own h1 is hidden — the page then has no h1; give TITLE_LEVEL "h1"
A CTA whose href is "" or "#" expecting it to do something by itself — with no href the button navigates nowhere; give it a route, or wire a behavior on {{ID}}-cta (trigger block:click)

placeholders.{{TITLE_LEVEL}}: heading level of the title: "h2" inside a page that has its own h1; "h1" when the empty state IS the page (a not-found view whose page heading is hidden)

{{CTA_LABEL}}.description: button.label — what the reader can do next; "" for no button

{{CTA_HREF}}.description: button.href — where the action goes (an app route such as /catalogue). "" for a behaviour-only button: it renders a <button> that navigates nowhere, and the page wires its click with a behavior on {{ID}}-cta (refresh a source, clear a filter, open a modal)
